About the Editors 
Bernard Grofman, Professor of Political Science, School of Social Sciences, 
University of California, Irvine, has as his principal area of expertise models 
of group decision making, with a focus on representation and comparative 
electoral systems, at the macrolevel, and jury decision making and pooling of 
expert judgments, at the microlevel.
